chunks.title: General AC Warranties & Core Technologies
chunks.content: All PEL Air Conditioners feature a 10 Years Compressor Warranty and 5 Years PCB kit Warranty. Core technologies include Platinum Shield Coating (2X durability against corrosion), InverterOn, R-32 eco-friendly refrigerant, Self-Clean Evaporator, and Wi-Fi Control.

chunks.model: Cool Breeze, Cool Pro, Atom, Eco Gear, Aero Extend, Fit Black, Jumbo DC Prime
chunks.title: 165V Startup Voltage Models
chunks.content: The following models operate with a minimal start-up voltage of 165 Volts: Cool Breeze InverterOn (12K/18K, R32), Cool Pro InverterOn (12K/18K, R32), Atom InverterOn (12K/18K, R32), Eco Gear/ACE PRO (12K/18K, R32), Aero Extend (12K/18K, R32), Fit Black T3 (12K/18K/24K, R410a), and Jumbo DC Prime (12K/18K/24K, R410a/R32).

chunks.title: 155V Startup Voltage Models
chunks.content: The Sublime Neo T3 InverterOn (12K/18K) features a minimal start-up voltage of 155 Volts, utilizes R32 refrigerant, and delivers powerful cooling up to 50°C (T3).

chunks.model: Fit Graphite, Turbo DC Ultimate, Jumbo X, Jumbo Cool, Jumbo Pro
chunks.title: 140V Ultra Low Startup Voltage Models
chunks.content: For extreme low voltage areas, PEL offers models with a minimal start-up voltage of 140 Volts: Fit Graphite T3 InverterOn (12K/18K/24K, R32), Turbo DC Ultimate T3 (12K/18K/24K, R32), Jumbo X T3 (12K/18K/24K, R32), Jumbo Cool (12K/18K/24K, R32), and Jumbo Pro T3 (12K/18K, R32).

chunks.title: Floor Standing Models
chunks.content: PEL Floor Standing ACs include: BOLD+ (R410a, 18M long distance airflow), SUPREME (R410a, Power Outage Memory feature), and ULTIMATE+ (R32, 18M airflow, self-clean). All are Heat & Cool capable with 4D Air Flow.
